LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Which words show direction and time? 2. Why is it important to show time and direction?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: Team work as learners, in pairs, play as they sign preposition games and songs.

• Digital Literacy: Interacting with digital devices as learner watch videos (supported with closed caption and sign interpreter) and online

material.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: Research skills as learners search for prepositions online, from newspapers magazines among others.

Values:
• Responsibility: Hard works as learners solve code words and crossword puzzles involving prepositions.

• Love: Sharing as learners display charts containing prepositions of time and direction

Link to other Subjects:

Learner relates the concept of prepositions to their learning in Kiswahili, Kenya sign Language and all other learning areas.

Suggested learning resources:

cross word puzzles, adapted course books, flash cards, dictionary, internet, signed audio-visual recordings, posters, pictures and photographs
